headline: Exercise is movement that strengthens—your body adapts to demands placed upon it
universal_truth: Bodies are built to move; use your capacity or lose it; what you don't use atrophies
fun_facts: Regular exercise reduces all-cause mortality by about 30%
Your brain grows new neurons during exercise—it's not just physical
Hunter-gatherers walked about 10 miles per day—our bodies evolved for movement
discussion_questions: How much are you moving compared to what your body expects?
What happens when you don't move enough?
What movement could you add that you'd actually enjoy?

hook.script: Your ancestors walked 10 miles daily, lifted heavy things, ran from predators. Your body expects movement. When you don't move, it interprets stillness as illness and starts shutting down. Movement isn't optional—it's required.

cliff.script: We know exercise is good, yet most people don't do enough. What makes movement so essential?

options.text: Bodies adapt to demands—they maintain capacity for what you do regularly and discard what you don't use; not moving signals 'don't need this' and capacity shrinks
options.response: Yes. Your body is efficient—it maintains only what you use. Stop moving, and it stops maintaining movement capacity. Use it or lose it isn't just a saying—it's biology.
Calories matter, but the deeper issue is capacity maintenance—your body adapts to demands...

fact1.title: Adaptation to Demands
fact1.script: Muscles grow when challenged. Bones strengthen under load. Hearts improve with cardio demands. Your body builds capacity for what you ask it to do—and removes capacity for what you don't.

fact2.title: Beyond Physical
fact2.script: Exercise isn't just physical—it improves mood, reduces anxiety, sharpens thinking. Your brain grows new neurons during movement. Mental and physical health are connected.

fact3.title: Minimum Effective Dose
fact3.script: You don't need hours. Even 20 minutes of movement triggers adaptation. Walking counts. Consistency beats intensity. The best exercise is the one you'll actually do.

wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Bodies are built to move. Use your capacity or lose it. What you don't use atrophies. Move regularly.

outro.script: That's Day 303. Tomorrow, we'll explore building stronger muscles—strength training. Until then, add some movement to your day.

growTrack.title: Movement Audit - How Much Do You Move?
growTrack.learning_objective: Assess current movement and plan improvements
growTrack.activity: How much do you move in a typical day? Walking, exercise, physical activity? Is it enough to maintain the capacity you want? What one addition would improve your movement pattern?
